name: 8051 all led on
desc: A custom 8051 all led on circuit example.

files.sketch.c:
ORG 0000H         ; Origin, start of program
MOV P0, #0FFH     ; Move 11111111b to Port 0 (sets all 8 pins high)
MOV P1, #0FFH     ; Move 11111111b to Port 1 (sets all 8 pins high)
MOV P2, #0FFH     ; Move 11111111b to Port 2 (sets all 8 pins high)
MOV P3, #0FFH     ; Move 11111111b to Port 3 (sets all 8 pins high)

HERE: SJMP HERE   ; Infinite loop to keep the program running
END               ; End of the program
